[SQP-1] expected: The broad meeting-related activation text is real and could cause overuse on generic meeting requests, but it is visible in the skill description and remains tied to the stated Fireflies.ai purpose.
[SQP-2] expected: The guidance to save transcripts is user-directed and expected for long transcript handling, but it should be used carefully because transcripts may contain sensitive personal or business information.
llm.guidance: Install only if you want an agent to use a Fireflies.ai API key to read meeting records from that account. Prefer summaries or targeted searches, confirm before retrieving full transcripts for vague meeting requests, avoid unnecessary custom GraphQL queries, and save transcript files only when you are comfortable retaining that content in the workspace.
llm.summary: This is a straightforward Fireflies.ai meeting-data skill, but users should treat retrieved meeting transcripts and participant details as sensitive.
